title: Greek Zucchini Pastitsio
description: A creative twist on the classic Greek pasta dish, incorporating zucchini for added flavor and nutrients.
instructions: Cook the pastitsio according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the grated zucchini and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the beef broth and bring to a simmer. Let cook for 2-3 minutes.
In a large baking dish, combine the cooked pastitsio, zucchini mixture, crumbled feta cheese, and grated parmesan cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the dish to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
